{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders: 6 rows with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Verify removal
print(f"Number of QA orders after removal: {(sales_clean['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()}")
print(f"Shape after removal: {sales_clean.shape}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment again
print(f"Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n{pd.crosstab(sales_clean['channel'], sales_clean['customer_segment'])}")"}
